scripts.build:mobile: MOBILE_BUILD=true next build && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: MOBILE_BUILD=true next build && npx cap sync ios && open -a Xcode ios/App/App.xcodeproj
scripts.ios:dev: DEV_SERVER_URL=http://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0):3000 CAPACITOR_DEV=true npx cap sync ios && open -a Xcode ios/App/App.xcodeproj
scripts.android: MOBILE_BUILD=true next build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:dev: DEV_SERVER_URL=http://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0):3000 CAPACITOR_DEV=true npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
